The present writ petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the First Information Report dated 20.07.2023 registered as Case Crime No.0103 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 504,

sentences.text: Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.
3. Smt. Manju Thakur, learned A.G.A.-I states that in the present matter, chargesheet has already been submitted before the competent court.
As such, the cause of filing the writ petition no more survives and the writ petition is liable to be dismissed as infructuous.
4. In view of the above, the writ petition is dismissed as infructuous with liberty to the petitioner to apply for bail as permissible under law and in accordance with law.
